I am old now, 60 years, and this small maize plot behind my house is only a tiny piece of my land. My husband's family worked this ground for many years, and I know what it gives. I will put a little DAP at planting if the cooperative brings it in time — maybe one small share of a bag, because the plot is too small for a whole bag. I keep two oxen and some goats, so manure I have, and I always spread it on this plot before ploughing. For seed I will use what I kept from last harvest, the local maize my neighbors also plant — the improved seed from the agro-dealer costs too much for such a small piece, and I am not sure the rains will be good this year.
